steps.content: Amid cheers and music, the marching crowd grows bigger and bigger.
Being in the crowd makes the bizarreness even more palpable.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...These people have terrible fashion taste, they dress worse than penniless Syndicans ten years ago.
You recall the documents about BR-001 you flipped through in the helicopter. The people in the parade are dressed in the same outfits as 23 years ago.

steps.speaker: Television Person
steps.content: Weather Forecast! Weather Forecast! Today is <color=#fb9259>June 27</color>, the weather is sunny! Sunny—!
The sky above the amusement park is indeed bright and clear, without a hint of cloudiness.

steps.speaker: Television Person
steps.content: Let's celebrate the passing of disasters and the reemergence of hope. In the days to come, the weather of the DisCity will keep on being sunny! <size=44>Sunny—!</size>
Time has been turned back to 23 years ago. Or rather, this carnival has been stuck in the day the Black Ring broke out.
You notice a crying clown next to you, the black and red paint all mixed up on his face.

steps.speaker: Weeping Clown
steps.content: There were so many fireworks in the sky... People were blown away by explosions, hahahaha... My dog too, and my family...

steps.speaker: Weeping Clown
steps.content: Hamel, dance, let me see them again, I want to see them again...

steps.speaker: Mascot
steps.content: I'm scared... Hamel, where are you, I'm so scared...

steps.speaker: Mascot
steps.content: I had nightmares again, Hamel, I need to see Hamel...

steps.speaker: Television Person
steps.content: Soothing all pain, bringing love and hope to everyone—

steps.speaker: Television Person
steps.content: Hamel's performance is about to begin! Come join us! Come join us—!

steps.speaker: Television Person
steps.content: New hope—terrible things will never happen again! The DisCity will always stay sunny—!
As Langley said, the Carnival was reopened to rebuild citizens' confidence. You can now genuinely feel the pain the great explosion of DisSea brought to the DisCity.
Because the pain is too excruciating, they long for comfort in imagination, long for Hamel's illusions.
You look toward Hella and Hecate who have been silent for a while, and find that they both look a bit dazed as well.
Hella and Hecate hear your voice, but it takes them a while to respond.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ugh... What just happened? Somehow my brain feels foggy...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The illusion has gotten more intense, meaning we're approaching the Carnival's center. If we keep following the parade, we will for sure find Hamel.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Let's go, I can keep going.

steps.content: Keep... what?
The crowd is slowly moving forward, and a strange white puppet appears between the gap. It doesn't follow the marching crowd and is staring at you quietly.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Be careful, this one is different from the other mascots.

steps.speaker: White Puppet
steps.content: Why must you keep going? If you're so scared, why must you keep going?
You feel no hostility from it, but instead you sense sadness in its exposed eyes.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Who are you?! Are you trying to kick us out too?

steps.speaker: White Puppet
steps.content: My name... is <color=#fb9259>Fear</color>.

steps.speaker: Fear Puppet
steps.content: Conscious human beings should not enter the Carnival, you shouldn't have come here.

steps.speaker: Fear Puppet
steps.content: The <color=#fb9259>Dancer</color> hopes that you can leave.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Watch out!
